subject: Private deployment starter bundle and SLA structuring — MediWise
messages:
From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@mediwise.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ken Park <ken.park@mediwise.com>, MediWise Procurement <procurement@mediwise.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing inquiry — MediWise

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement and engineering asked me to get a written summary of options and rough numbers for a private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) so we can evaluate commercial fit. High level asks below — apologies if some overlap with the questionnaire I attached: (see attached mediwise_procurement_q1.xlsx)

- Target: 24-month initial deployment, production traffic starting Q1 2027 (pilot in Q4 2026).
- Expected steady-state token volume: approx 12M tokens/day (inference), peak 20M/day.
- Wants: a Starter pack to validate in 2 sites, then roll to 6 additional sites over year 2.
- Questions we need answered: platform fee treatment (one‑time vs amortized), on‑prem license vs per‑node consumption, recommended support tier for mission‑critical workflows, and typical SLA credits/penalties.
- Timeline: procurement would like indicative pricing and a proposed SOW by next Thursday (2026-09-16).

Can you confirm you can share a two-tiered option set (pilot/starter and enterprise roll) + an amortization example for the platform fee? Also send any required contracting steps (DocuSign links are fine).

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 30m call if that helps.

Thanks,
Laura Gibbs
Senior Procurement Manager | MediWise
laura.gibbs@mediwise.com
(415) 555-0112

Attachments: mediwise_procurement_q1.xlsx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@mediwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing inquiry — MediWise

Hi Laura — thanks, and thanks for the questionnaire. We can absolutely put together a short, two‑option commercial that covers: pilot/starter bundle + recommended enterprise roll plan with amortization examples for the platform fee and a few discounting scenarios for a 24‑month commit.

To make the proposal precise, two quick clarifying Qs:
1) Do you consider the two pilot sites production (incur full licensing) or do you want a discounted dev/pilot rate for the first 3 months?
2) Any constraint on on‑prem licensing model preference (per‑GPU node license vs capped concurrent sessions / throughput band)?

We’ve attached an internal worksheet (redwood_privdeploy_pricing_v1.pdf) with ballpark numbers; Marissa will finalize trims, Naomi will validate amortization and billing cadence, Dylan will confirm install/onboarding SOW line items.

Proposed next steps: I’ll send a short, optioned proposal tomorrow EOD (2026‑09‑09). If that timeline is too tight, let me know and we’ll move the SOW target.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed starter/enterprise bundles for MediWise (internal)

Evelyn / team — draft pricing for MediWise based on the questionnaire + token estimates. Numbers here are list / example discounts; want to keep a conservative fallback.

Option A — Starter Pilot (2 sites)
- One‑time platform fee: $200,000 (can be amortized monthly over term)
- Pilot license: 2 reserved operator nodes + 1 staging node = $18,000/month (node license model)
- Support: Standard (business hours, 8x5) — $5,000/month
- Professional services (install + runbook + 2 onsite days/site): one‑time $45,000
- Recommended discount for 24‑month commit: 10% off license line items (not platform fee)

Option B — Enterprise Roll (scale to 8 sites)
- One‑time platform fee: $200,000 (same) with optional amortization over 24 months = $8,333/month
- Production licenses (8 sites): $72,000/month (node mix)
- Support: Premium (24x7 SRE + 4hr response for P1) — $22,000/month
- PS & onboarding: $120,000 one‑time
- Volume discounts: 18% on license lines for 24‑month commit; additional 3% if payment is upfront

Notes and rationale:
- Platform fee amortization: finance prefers amortize to match customer ARR recognition; Naomi can provide exact invoice language and suggested amortization schedule.
- SLA credits: standard penalty schedule (service credits up to 10% of monthly invoice for repeat P1 misses) — legal to finalize.
- Bill cadence: monthly invoicing preferred; can support quarterly for enterprise if negotiated.

Attachments: proposed_SOW_mediwise_v1.docx, mediwise_procurement_q1.xlsx

Marissa — numbers here are intentionally rounded. Naomi, can you confirm whether we can offer an additional one‑time onboarding credit ($25k) if they commit to the enterprise option within 45 days? Also, Dylan — confirm the PS scope and estimate for multi‑site rollout.

—Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@mediwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing inquiry — MediWise

Hi Laura — following up with two clean options and a short explanation of platform fee treatment. Attached: redwood_privdeploy_pricing_v1.pdf (numbers), proposed_SOW_mediwise_v1.docx (SOW).

Summary: (all numbers are indicative; final proposal subject to security review + SOW acceptance)

1) Starter Pilot (recommended for Q4 2026 pilot)
- Platform fee: $200k one‑time (we can invoice as upfront or amortize monthly over the 24‑month term; example amortized: $8,333/mo).
- Licenses: $18k/mo for pilot nodes (after 10% 24‑month commit discount = $16,200/mo).
- Support: Standard — $5k/mo.
- PS: $45k one‑time.

2) Enterprise Roll (scale to 8 sites in year 2) — projected from pilot metrics
- Platform fee: same $200k (already paid at pilot conversion — credit back if consolidated at contract signature).
- Licenses: $72k/mo pre‑discount; with 18% commit discount = $59,040/mo.
- Support: Premium (24x7) — $22k/mo.
- PS: $120k one‑time; we can offer a $25k onboarding credit if enterprise is signed within 45 days of pilot completion.

Other commercial points:
- SLA credits: typical schedule applies; for mission‑critical use we recommend Premium support.
- Billing: monthly by default; we can accept quarterly prepay for additional 3% off license lines.
- Contracting: we’ll send a redlineable SOW + Master Subscription Agreement. DocuSign flow available.

Next step: can we schedule a 30‑minute alignment call to walk through the SOW and confirm pilot node sizing? Proposed slots: Thu 2026‑09‑10 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 2026‑09‑10 15:00–15:30 PT.

If those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and the DocuSign starter SOW.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Attachments: redwood_privdeploy_pricing_v1.pdf, proposed_SOW_mediwise_v1.docx
